# bioexcel/biobb_vs/autodock_vina_run

## Summary

Wrapper of the AutoDock Vina software.

This class performs docking of the ligand to a set of grids describing the target protein via the AutoDock Vina software.

Nextflow adapter of the [AutoDockVinaRun](https://biobb-vs.readthedocs.io/en/latest/vina.html#module-vina.autodock_vina_run) building block of [biobb_vs](https://github.com/bioexcel/biobb_vs) 5.3.0.

## Get started

```nextflow
include { BIOBB_VS_AUTODOCK_VINA_RUN } from 'bioexcel/biobb_vs/autodock_vina_run'

workflow {
    BIOBB_VS_AUTODOCK_VINA_RUN(ch_input)
}
```

Optional input files are passed as `[]`.

## Inputs

| Name | Required | Formats | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `meta` | yes | | Map with at least an `id` key, used as tag and output file prefix |
| `input_ligand_pdbqt_path` | yes | pdbqt | Path to the input PDBQT ligand |
| `input_receptor_pdbqt_path` | yes | pdbqt | Path to the input PDBQT receptor |
| `input_box_path` | yes | pdb | Path to the PDB containig the residues belonging to the binding site |

## Outputs

Each output channel emits `[meta, file]`. Files are named `<prefix>_<role>.<extension>`, where role is the output argument without `output_` and `_path`.
Optional outputs are only produced if requested in `ext.outputs`.

| Channel | Required | Formats (default first) | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `output_pdbqt_path` | yes | pdbqt | Path to the output PDBQT file |
| `output_log_path` | no, opt-in | log | Path to the log file |
| `versions_biobb_vs` | yes | | `[process, 'biobb_vs', version]`, also sent to the `versions` topic |

## Configuration

Set with `ext` in a `process` `withName` selector:

| Option | Description |
|---|---|
| `ext.properties` | Map of AutoDockVinaRun properties (see below). Defaults: `[can_write_file_log: false]` |
| `ext.outputs` | Map of output argument to extension, for example `[output_log_path: 'log']`. Required outputs use their first format by default; optional outputs are only requested when listed here |
| `ext.prefix` | Output file prefix (default: `meta.id`) |

`raise_error` and `restart` are always set by the adapter: failed commands fail the task, and `-resume` replaces restart.
Do not set the `container_*` properties: Nextflow runs the task inside the biobb_vs container.

```groovy
process {
    withName: 'BIOBB_VS_AUTODOCK_VINA_RUN' {
        ext.properties = [cpu: 1]
    }
}
```

### Properties

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `cpu` | integer | 1 | the number of CPUs to use. |
| `exhaustiveness` | integer | 8 | exhaustiveness of the global search (roughly proportional to time). |
| `num_modes` | integer | 9 | maximum number of binding modes to generate. |
| `min_rmsd` | integer | 1 | minimum RMSD between output poses. |
| `energy_range` | integer | 3 | maximum energy difference between the best binding mode and the worst one displayed (kcal/mol). |
| `binary_path` | string | "vina" | path to vina in your local computer. |
| `remove_tmp` | boolean | true | Remove temporal files. |
| `sandbox_path` | string | "./" | Parent path to the sandbox directory. |
